newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: First Capital buys shares in HK company.
newsitem.headline: First Capital buys shares in HK company.

text.p: First Capital Corp (FCC) said on Saturday it agreed to buy 20.26 million shares totalling Hong Kong $187 million (Singapore $34 million) from Guoco Group Ltd.
The Guoco Group has an interest of about 58 percent in FCC, and had on November 2 announced its acquisition of 71.6 percent in Lap Heng Company Ltd, a Hong Kong publicly-listed company.
The purchase by FCC of the sale shares at HK$2.00 each will be financed from internal cash resources.
Lap Heng was formerly in the business of watch manufacturing and distribution, but will become a property investment and development company.

The sale will be finalised no later than April 30, 1997, and FCC will hold about 20 percent and Guoco Group will continue to hold more than 50 percent of the enlarged issued share capital of Lap Heng, FCC said in a statement.
FCC's acquisition is not expected to have an effect on the FCC Group's net tangible assets or earnings per share for the current financial year.
